baslik: Two Pilots Took an Empty Jet to Its Ceiling for Fun

sahneler.metin: An empty regional jet crashed in Missouri after both engines stopped.
They were repositioning the jet with no passengers.
For fun, they climbed to its maximum altitude of forty one thousand feet.
The jet couldn't hold speed up there and stalled.
Their cores locked up and wouldn't restart.
Training on high-altitude flying and restarts was strengthened.

aciklama:
Pinnacle 3701 crashed after both engines flamed out. The cause: stall and engine flameout at 41,000 ft, then engine core lock preventing restart.
